regexCodeList.string: ^You see your own dead body from above\.$
^You place an? ([A-Za-z]{1,10}) totem in the room\.$
^<> Your totem has been killed by (\w{3,12})\.$
^Your eye of vigilance has closed for the last time\.$
^You remove your eye of vigilance from (.*)\.$
^You are affected by the following skills/spells:$

Script.name: spellups
Script.script:
if not (aardkit and aardkit.util and aardkit.register) then if cecho then cecho("\n[Spellups] needs Aardkit Core. Install that first - Toolbox > Module Manager, priority 1.\n") end return end --[[ Spellups — state engine (stage 1) Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31 Knows what you can cast, what's currently on you, what's blocked by a recovery, and why the last cast failed. It does NOT cast anything — that's stage 2, and it only gets built once this half is proven against live tag traffic. A half-working auto-caster is worse than none. Built from docs/aardwolf-spelltags.md, which was written from Aardwolf's own published protocol and a live slist. Hadar's plugin showed the idea was worth having; no code, structure or naming came from it. See CREDITS.md. The one idea worth stating: {sfail} tells you WHY a cast failed, and each reason has exactly one correct response. That's a table, not a pile of conditionals, and it's the whole reason a tag-driven caster beats a keybind that fires the same list blind. ]] aardkit = aardkit or {} aardkit.spellup = aardkit.spellup or {} local SP = aardkit.spellup local U = aardkit.util.named("Spellups") local CFG = U.load("spellups", { warn30 = true, warn10 = true, channel = "echo", decay = 60, -- how long a fallen buff stays on the panel before fading out view = "up", -- which button is pressed: up | gone }) --- -- state --- SP.skills = SP.skills or {} -- skillnum -> {name,target,duration,prac,recovery,type} SP.byname = SP.byname or {} -- name -> skillnum SP.recov = SP.recov or {} -- recnum -> name SP.affect = SP.affect or {} -- skillnum -> expiry epoch -- skillnum -> true, once the MUD has sent a real {affon} with seconds on it. -- -- The skill table can't tell us this. 'slist' reports duration=0 for all 619 -- skills - sanctuary, fly and cure light alike - so that column is not a buff -- length and filtering on it would empty the panel. What actually separates a -- buff from an instant heal is whether the MUD ever announces an affect for it, -- and it only does that for things that last. So we learn it by watching. SP.hasdur = SP.hasdur or {} SP.blocked = SP.blocked or {} -- recnum -> expiry epoch SP.failed = SP.failed or {} -- skillnum -> {code=, at=} SP.dropped = SP.dropped or {} -- skillnum -> when it fell off SP.nope = SP.nope or {} -- skillnum -> true, MUD says you don't have it -- The skill table only changes when your class does, so there's no reason to -- pull 619 rows off the MUD every single launch. Cache it and re-read on the -- events that actually invalidate it. function SP.saveskills() U.save("spellskills", { skills = SP.skills, recov = SP.recov }) end function SP.loadskills() local d = U.load("spellskills", { skills = {}, recov = {} }) local n = 0 -- keys come back as strings if the save round-tripped through anything that -- stringifies them, so normalise rather than trusting what's on disk for k, sk in pairs(d.skills or {}) do local id = tonumber(k) if id and type(sk) == "table" and sk.name then SP.skills[id] = sk SP.byname[sk.name:lower()] = id n = n + 1 end end for k, name in pairs(d.recov or {}) do local id = tonumber(k) if id then SP.recov[id] = name end end return n end -- from the protocol doc; see the {sfail} table there local FAIL = { [1] = { "lost concentration", "retry" }, [2] = { "already affected", "mark-up" }, [3] = { "blocked by recovery", "wait-recovery" }, [4] = { "not enough mana", "backoff" }, [5] = { "nocast room", "wait-room" }, [6] = { "cannot concentrate", "retry" }, [8] = { "unknown spell", "never" }, [9] = { "self-only cast on other", "fix-target" }, [10] = { "resting or sitting", "stand" }, [11] = { "disabled", "never" }, [12] = { "not enough moves", "backoff" }, } SP.FAIL = FAIL -- target codes, confirmed against the live slist local SELF_OK = { [2] = true, [3] = true } -- 2 = self or other, 3 = self only local function is_spellup(s) -- a spell (type 1) you can put on yourself, that lasts a while return s and s.type == 1 and SELF_OK[s.target] == true end SP.is_spellup = is_spellup --- -- slist ingest -- -- The rows between the markers aren't tagged, so they need a catch-all — armed -- only for the block, released on the closing marker, with a safety timer. Same -- shape as the tag gag and Who Poller. --- local ing_trig, ing_timer, ingesting = nil, nil, nil local function ingest_stop() ingesting = nil if ing_trig then killTrigger(ing_trig); ing_trig = nil end if ing_timer then killTimer(ing_timer); ing_timer = nil end end local function ingest_row() local line = getCurrentLine() U.gag() -- we own this block, so we hide it too if line:find("^{/") then local what = ingesting ingest_stop() if what == "spells" then local n = 0 for _ in pairs(SP.skills) do n = n + 1 end U.ok("Spellups: read " .. n .. " skills.") elseif what == "recoveries" then -- table's complete; cache it, then find out what's already running SP.saveskills() if SP.classdiff then SP.classdiff() end tempTimer(1, function() SP.sync() end) end return end if ingesting == "spells" then -- skillnum,name,target,duration,prac,recovery,type local num, name, target, dur, prac, rec, kind = line:match("^(%d+),(.-),(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+)%s*$") if num then local id = tonumber(num) SP.skills[id] = { name = name, target = tonumber(target), duration = tonumber(dur), prac = tonumber(prac), recovery = tonumber(rec), type = tonumber(kind), } SP.byname[name:lower()] = id end elseif ingesting == "recoveries" then -- recnum,name,seconds local num, name = line:match("^(%d+),(.-),(%-?%d+)%s*$") if num then SP.recov[tonumber(num)] = name end end end local function ingest_start(what) ingest_stop() ingesting = what ing_trig = tempRegexTrigger("^.*$", ingest_row) ing_timer = tempTimer(20, function() if ingesting then ingest_stop() U.warn("Spellups: " .. tostring(what) .. " block never closed.") end end) end function SP.on_spellheaders() U.gag() ingest_start("spells") SP.skills, SP.byname = {}, {} end function SP.on_recoveries() U.gag() ingest_start("recoveries") SP.recov = {} end --- -- live state --- local warned = {} -- skillnum -> { [30]=true, [10]=true } -- One way in, so no path can set an affect and forget to record that the spell -- lasts. That already happened once: the 'aff' sync set SP.affect directly, the -- panel filters on SP.hasdur, and a night vision with 37 minutes left showed as -- "Nothing running". function SP.mark(num, secs) num, secs = tonumber(num), tonumber(secs) if not num then return end if (secs or 0) > 0 then SP.hasdur[num] = true end SP.affect[num] = os.time() + (secs or 0) end function SP.on_affon(num, secs) num, secs = tonumber(num), tonumber(secs) if not num then return end SP.mark(num, secs) SP.failed[num] = nil SP.dropped[num] = nil warned[num] = nil end function SP.on_affoff(num) num = tonumber(num) if not num then return end if SP.affect[num] then SP.dropped[num] = os.time() end SP.affect[num] = nil warned[num] = nil -- some effects come from worn items rather than casts if SP.on_aura_drop then SP.on_aura_drop(num) end -- wraith form drops others when it lands, so pre-cast rather than chase it if SP.skills[num] and SP.skills[num].name == "wraith form" and SP.wraith_pre then SP.wraith_pre() end end function SP.on_sfail(num, target, code, rec) num, code = tonumber(num), tonumber(code) if not num then return end SP.failed[num] = { code = code, at = os.time(), recovery = tonumber(rec) } -- Codes 8 and 11 mean it's never going to work — you don't have the spell, -- or it's disabled. Say so once so it isn't a mystery why it stopped being -- attempted, then drop it and move on. Silence here reads as a bug. if SP.on_castfail then SP.on_castfail(code) end local d = FAIL[code] if d and d[2] == "never" then local s = SP.skills[num] if not SP.nope[num] then U.note("You don't have " .. ((s and s.name) or num) .. " (" .. d[1] .. ").") end SP.nope[num] = true SP.dropped[num] = nil end -- "already affected" is information, not a failure: the MUD is telling us -- our picture is stale -- "already affected" means it IS an affect, so it counts as one that lasts - -- but the 60s is a guess standing in until a real {affon} arrives. if code == 2 then SP.mark(num, 60) end end function SP.on_recon(num, secs) num, secs = tonumber(num), tonumber(secs) if not num then return end SP.blocked[num] = os.time() + (secs or 0) end function SP.on_recoff(num) num = tonumber(num) if not num then return end SP.blocked[num] = nil -- totem and eye are gated by recovery, not duration; this is their cue if SP.on_recovery_clear then SP.on_recovery_clear(num) end end function SP.on_skillgain(num, pct) num, pct = tonumber(num), tonumber(pct) local s = num and SP.skills[num] if s then s.prac = pct or s.prac end end --- -- seeding from 'aff' -- -- Confirmed live: {affon} only fires on a fresh cast. Anything already running -- when you log in is invisible to the tag stream, so the picture starts blank -- and stays wrong until each spell happens to recast. Reading 'aff' once fixes -- that - it is the only way to learn what you're already under. --- local sync_trig, sync_timer, syncing = nil, nil, false local function sync_stop() syncing = false if sync_trig then killTrigger(sync_trig); sync_trig = nil end if sync_timer then killTimer(sync_timer); sync_timer = nil end end local synced = 0 local function sync_row() local line = getCurrentLine() -- the skills/spells list ends at the special-affects header or the summary if line:find("special affects") or line:find("^You are affected by %d") or line:find("^You are not affected") then sync_stop() -- 'aff' just told us everything that's actually up - anything else that's -- a spellup is down, whether or not it's ever been cast this session. Without -- this, downcount() only counts spells that have gone through an affon/affoff -- cycle, so a fresh login sits under threshold forever even with nothing up. for _, id in ipairs(SP.spellups()) do if not SP.affect[id] and not SP.nope[id] then SP.dropped[id] = SP.dropped[id] or os.time() end end U.ok("Spellups: synced " .. synced .. " running affect(s) from 'aff'.") return end -- " Detect invis : sets detect invis effect (00:15)" -- and the longer "(01:02:03)" form for anything lasting over an hour local name, a, b, c = line:match("^%s%s(.-)%s*:%s*.-%((%d+):(%d+):(%d+)%)%s*$") if not name then name, a, b = line:match("^%s%s(.-)%s*:%s*.-%((%d+):(%d+)%)%s*$") c = nil end if not name then return end local secs = c and (tonumber(a) * 3600 + tonumber(b) * 60 + tonumber(c)) or (tonumber(a) * 60 + tonumber(b)) local id = SP.byname[name:lower()] if id then -- 'aff' only ever lists things that are running with time left, so this -- is as good a duration as an {affon} SP.mark(id, secs) synced = synced + 1 end end function SP.on_affheader() sync_stop() syncing = true synced = 0 sync_trig = tempRegexTrigger("^.*$", sync_row) sync_timer = tempTimer(6, function() if syncing then sync_stop() end end) end function SP.sync() if next(SP.skills) == nil then U.warn("Spellups: no skill table yet - run 'spellup slist' first.") return end send("aff", false) end --- -- queries --- -- seconds left, or nil when it isn't up function SP.left(num) local t = SP.affect[num] if not t then return nil end local d = t - os.time() if d <= 0 then SP.affect[num] = nil; return nil end return d end -- is this spell unavailable because its recovery is running? function SP.recovering(num) local s = SP.skills[num] if not s or (s.recovery or -1) < 0 then return nil end local t = SP.blocked[s.recovery] if not t then return nil end local d = t - os.time() if d <= 0 then SP.blocked[s.recovery] = nil; return nil end return d, SP.recov[s.recovery] or ("recovery " .. s.recovery) end -- everything we'd consider a spellup, sorted by name function SP.spellups() local out = {} for id, s in pairs(SP.skills) do if is_spellup(s) then out[#out + 1] = id end end table.sort(out, function(a, b) return SP.skills[a].name < SP.skills[b].name end) return out end --- -- expiry warnings --- local MARKS = { 30, 10 } -- hoisted so this doesn't build a fresh table every spell, every tick function SP.tick() if not (CFG.warn30 or CFG.warn10) then return end for num in pairs(SP.affect) do local d = SP.left(num) if d then local s = SP.skills[num] warned[num] = warned[num] or {} for _, mark in ipairs(MARKS) do local want = (mark == 30 and CFG.warn30) or (mark == 10 and CFG.warn10) if want and d <= mark and not warned[num][mark] then warned[num][mark] = true local msg = (s and s.name or ("spell " .. num)) .. " falls in " .. mark .. "s" if CFG.channel == "echo" then U.warn(msg) else send(CFG.channel .. " " .. msg, false) end end end end end end --- -- panel --- --- -- the two views -- -- Up is what you're running. Gone is what fell off in the last minute and is -- worth recasting. Anything older than that is neither - it's a potion or a -- gear affect you were never going to recast, and leaving it on screen just -- made the panel something you stopped reading. --- local BTN_H = 20 local tabs = {} -- the paint frame cache, declared up here because SP.on_view has to be able to -- invalidate it: switching view changes the output without changing the data, -- and a stale frame comparison would swallow the repaint entirely local buf, lastframe = {}, nil -- declared before tab() so the closure below binds this local and not a global -- of the same name, which is nil forever local panel local function tab(key, label, x, w) if not tabs[key] then tabs[key] = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "aardkit_sp_" .. key .. "_" .. (panel and panel.gen or 1), x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = BTN_H - 2, }, panel.container) tabs[key]:setClickCallback("aardkit.spellup.on_view", key) end local b = tabs[key] b:move(x, 2) b:resize(w, BTN_H - 2) local on = (CFG.view == key) b:setStyleSheet(string.format( "background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 3px;", on and "#274060" or "#1b2540", on and "#e94560" or "#3a4a6b")) b:echo(string.format("
%s
", on and "#c8d0dc" or "#8a93a8", label)) b:show() return b end panel = aardkit.panel.new({ name = "spellups", title = "Spellups", width = 300, height = 340, x = "20px", y = "120px", fontSize = 9, -- laid out by hand, so it has to be told when the panel changes size onresize = function() if aardkit.spellup.paint then aardkit.spellup.paint() end end, -- _build hands back a brand-new container on a dock/embed switch, so the -- cached labels are pointing into the old one onbuild = function() tabs = {} if aardkit.spellup.paint then aardkit.spellup.paint() end end, }) function SP.on_view(which) -- refresh shares the tab strip but isn't a view; it asks the MUD and -- leaves you looking at whatever you were already looking at if which == "refresh" then if SP.refresh then SP.refresh() end return end CFG.view = (which == "gone") and "gone" or "up" U.save("spellups", CFG) lastframe = nil -- the frame differs even when the data hasn't SP.paint() end SP.panel = panel -- MMM:SS, zero-padded so the column doesn't jitter as it counts down. The panel -- repaints every second, so this is a live clock, not a snapshot. local function fmt(secs) secs = math.max(0, math.floor(secs or 0)) return string.format("%03d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60) end -- Only what's actually relevant: what's on you now, and what just fell off. The -- full 186-spell list of things you aren't running is noise - 'spellup list' is -- there when you want the whole inventory. -- -- A dropped buff goes red and then fades out over CFG.decay. Plenty of them come -- from potions and gear and were never yours to recast, so nothing sits there -- accusing you forever. -- Reused across repaints. The panel redraws once a second to keep the clocks -- honest, so anything allocated here is allocated 86400 times a day - build the -- frame in one buffer and hand it over in a single write. -- bright red at the moment it drops, sinking toward the background as it ages local function fadecol(t) t = math.min(1, math.max(0, t)) return string.format("#%02x%02x%02x", math.floor(247 - 202 * t), math.floor(118 - 88 * t), math.floor(142 - 102 * t)) end function SP.paint() if not panel.console then return end local c = panel.console if panel.container then local w = U.px(panel.container.get_width and panel.container:get_width() or panel.container.width) if w < 60 then w = 300 end -- two views and a refresh, the refresh narrow because it's pressed -- rarely and the labels beside it are what you read local rw = 74 local half = math.floor((w - 16 - rw) / 2) tab("up", "Current", 4, half) tab("gone", "Dropped", 8 + half, half) tab("refresh", "refresh", 12 + half * 2, rw) -- the console starts below the buttons rather than under them pcall(function() c:move(0, BTN_H + 2) c:resize("100%", "-" .. (BTN_H + 2) .. "px") end) end local n = 0 local function put(s) n = n + 1; buf[n] = s end if next(SP.skills) == nil then put("<#8a93a8>No skill table yet.\nRun 'spellup slist'.\n") else local now = os.time() local up, gone = {}, {} for id in pairs(SP.affect) do local left = SP.left(id) -- SP.hasdur: only things the MUD has actually announced an affect -- for. A cure light never lasts and never belonged on here. if left and SP.skills[id] and SP.hasdur[id] then up[#up + 1] = { id = id, left = left } end end for id, at in pairs(SP.dropped) do local age = now - at if not SP.skills[id] or not SP.hasdur[id] or age > CFG.decay then SP.dropped[id] = nil SP.failed[id] = nil -- prune alongside; nothing else does else gone[#gone + 1] = { id = id, age = age } end end table.sort(up, function(a, b) return a.left < b.left end) table.sort(gone, function(a, b) return a.age < b.age end) -- one view at a time; the buttons say which if CFG.view == "gone" then up = {} else gone = {} end if #up == 0 and #gone == 0 then put(CFG.view == "gone" and "<#8a93a8>Nothing dropped in the last minute.\n" or "<#8a93a8>Nothing running.\n") else local w = 0 for _, e in ipairs(up) do w = math.max(w, #SP.skills[e.id].name) end for _, e in ipairs(gone) do w = math.max(w, #SP.skills[e.id].name) end w = math.min(w, 24) for _, e in ipairs(up) do -- green while comfortable, amber as it gets close, red about to go local col = e.left <= 30 and "#f7768e" or (e.left <= 120 and "#e0af68" or "#3ad07a") local rec, recname = SP.recovering(e.id) put(string.format("<%s>%-" .. w .. "s %8s%s\n", col, SP.skills[e.id].name:sub(1, w), fmt(e.left), rec and (" <#8a93a8>" .. (recname or "") .. "") or "")) end if #gone > 0 then if #up > 0 then put("<#3a4a6b>" .. string.rep("-", w + 9) .. "\n") end for _, e in ipairs(gone) do local col = fadecol(e.age / CFG.decay) local f = SP.failed[e.id] local why = "" if f and FAIL[f.code] then why = " <#8a93a8>" .. FAIL[f.code][1] .. "" end put(string.format("<%s>%-" .. w .. "s %8s%s\n", col, SP.skills[e.id].name:sub(1, w), "-" .. fmt(e.age), why)) end end end end -- One frame, one comparison, one write. When nothing on screen would look -- different there's no reason to touch the console at all - which is most -- ticks once things settle down. local frame = table.concat(buf, "", 1, n) for i = 1, n do buf[i] = nil end if frame == lastframe then return end lastframe = frame c:clear() U.outw(c.name, frame) end --- -- commands --- function SP.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg) -- 'x opacity 200' where somebody looks for it, rather than only -- 'panel x opacity 200'. One line; core does the work. if aardkit.panel.verb("spellups", verb, rest) then return end -- autocast owns auto/now; extras own totem/eye/aura/wraith if SP.autocmd and SP.autocmd(verb, rest) then return end if SP.extrascmd and SP.extrascmd(verb, rest) then return end if verb == "toggle" or verb == "panel" then SP.paint() panel:show() elseif verb == "reclass" then SP.reslist("reclass") elseif verb == "slist" then U.note("Spellups: reading the skill table...") -- ONE command: 'slist spells' emits {spellheaders spells} AND -- {recoveries spells}. Sending a second slist lands in the middle of -- 619 streaming rows and tears down the capture that's still running. send("slist spells", false) elseif verb == "sync" then SP.sync() elseif verb == "list" then local ups = SP.spellups() if #ups == 0 then U.note("No skill table yet. Run 'spellup slist'."); return end U.note(#ups .. " spellups known:") for _, id in ipairs(ups) do local left = SP.left(id) local rec, recname = SP.recovering(id) local state = left and ("up " .. fmt(left)) or (rec and ("blocked " .. fmt(rec) .. " " .. (recname or ""))) or "down" U.out(string.format("\n <#c8d0dc>%-26s <#8a93a8>%-4d %s", SP.skills[id].name, id, state)) end echo("\n") elseif verb == "why" then local key = U.trim(rest):lower() local id = tonumber(key) or SP.byname[key] local f = id and SP.failed[id] if not id or not SP.skills[id] then U.warn("Don't know a spell called '" .. key .. "'.") elseif not f then U.note(SP.skills[id].name .. ": nothing failed recently.") else local d = FAIL[f.code] U.help(SP.skills[id].name, { { "failed", d and d[1] or ("code " .. tostring(f.code)) }, { "policy", d and d[2] or "unknown" }, { "when", U.duration(os.time() - f.at) .. " ago" }, { "recovery", f.recovery and f.recovery >= 0 and (SP.recov[f.recovery] or tostring(f.recovery)) or "-" }, }) end elseif verb == "warn" then local which = U.trim(rest):lower() if which == "30" then CFG.warn30 = not CFG.warn30 elseif which == "10" then CFG.warn10 = not CFG.warn10 else U.warn("Usage: spellup warn 30|10"); return end U.save("spellups", CFG) U.ok(string.format("Warnings: 30s %s, 10s %s", CFG.warn30 and "on" or "off", CFG.warn10 and "on" or "off")) elseif verb == "decay" then local n = tonumber(U.trim(rest)) if not n or n < 0 or n > 3600 then U.warn("Usage: spellup decay (currently " .. CFG.decay .. ")") else CFG.decay = math.floor(n); U.save("spellups", CFG) U.ok("Fallen buffs stay on the panel for " .. CFG.decay .. "s.") end elseif verb == "channel" then local c = U.trim(rest):match("^(%S+)") if c then CFG.channel = c U.save("spellups", CFG) U.ok("Spellup warnings go to: " .. c) else U.note("Warnings go to: " .. CFG.channel) end elseif verb == "dock" then panel:setmode("dock") elseif verb == "embed" then panel:setmode("embed") elseif verb == "hide" then panel:hide() elseif verb == "status" then local n, ups, rec = 0, #SP.spellups(), 0 for _ in pairs(SP.skills) do n = n + 1 end for _ in pairs(SP.recov) do rec = rec + 1 end local upcount = 0 for id in pairs(SP.affect) do if SP.left(id) then upcount = upcount + 1 end end U.help("Spellups", { { "skills known", tostring(n) }, { "spellups", tostring(ups) }, { "recoveries", tostring(rec) }, { "currently up", tostring(upcount) }, { "warnings", (CFG.warn30 and "30s " or "") .. (CFG.warn10 and "10s" or "") .. " -> " .. CFG.channel }, { "autocast", (SP.AC and SP.AC.on) and ("on, fires at " .. SP.AC.threshold .. " down") or "off" }, }) else U.help("Spellups", { { "spellup", "the panel: what's up, down, blocked" }, { "spellup list", "every spellup and its state" }, { "spellup why ", "why the last cast of it failed" }, { "spellup slist", "re-read the skill table from the MUD" }, { "spellup reclass", "changed class: re-read and diff against the old set" }, { "spellup auto", "autocast: sends 'spellup' once enough is down" }, { "spellup now", "send 'spellup' right now" }, { "spellup sync", "read 'aff' to learn what's already up" }, { "spellup decay ", "how long a fallen buff stays listed" }, { "spellup warn 30|10", "toggle expiry warnings" }, { "spellup channel ", "where warnings go ('echo' for here)" }, { "spellup status", "counts" }, { "spellup totem", "totem tracking and recast" }, { "spellup eye", "eye of vigilance" }, { "spellup aura", "wear an item when its affect drops" }, { "spellup wraith", "pre-cast set before wraith form" }, { "spellup dock|embed|hide", "" }, { "spellup opacity <0-255>", "how solid this window is; 'default' follows the shared setting" }, { "" }, { "It only ever sends 'spellup' - the MUD picks the spells," }, { "and gates on mana, recoveries, nomagic rooms, sleeping," }, { "combat and affects you already have. It knows more than" }, { "we do. 'forgetskill' drops one; 'quickskill' sets order." }, }) end end --- -- the table can change under you -- -- Remort, class change and tier reset the skill list. Casting from a stale table -- means casting things you no longer have, which the MUD answers with {sfail} 8 -- for every one of them. Re-read instead. --- function SP.reslist(why) U.note("Spellups: " .. why .. " - re-reading the skill table.") -- hang on to the old spellup set so the new one can be diffed against it SP.prevups = {} for _, id in ipairs(SP.spellups()) do SP.prevups[id] = true end -- every "you don't have that" was an answer about the OLD class SP.affect, SP.blocked, SP.failed, SP.dropped, SP.nope = {}, {}, {}, {}, {} tempTimer(2, function() send("slist spells", false) end) end -- What the new table gained and lost. Worth saying out loud: the auto flags were -- decisions made about a different class, and nothing else is going to tell you -- that a dozen new spellups just showed up switched off. function SP.classdiff() if not SP.prevups then return end local prev = SP.prevups SP.prevups = nil local gained, lost = {}, {} local now = {} for _, id in ipairs(SP.spellups()) do now[id] = true if not prev[id] then gained[#gained + 1] = id end end for id in pairs(prev) do if not now[id] then lost[#lost + 1] = id end end if #gained == 0 and #lost == 0 then return end local function names(t) local out = {} for _, id in ipairs(t) do out[#out + 1] = (SP.skills[id] and SP.skills[id].name) or id end table.sort(out) return table.concat(out, ", ") end if #lost > 0 then U.note("Spellups: lost " .. #lost .. " - " .. names(lost)) end if #gained > 0 then U.ok("Spellups: gained " .. #gained .. " - " .. names(gained)) end end function SP.on_classchange() SP.reslist("class changed") end function SP.on_remort() SP.reslist("remort") end -- death drops most affects; the MUD sends {affoff} for each, but a stale picture -- is worse than an empty one function SP.on_death() SP.affect = {} U.note("Spellups: died - affects cleared.") end --- -- boot --- -- Aardwolf sends char.status once you're actually in the game. sysConnectionEvent -- is too early - anything sent then lands on the login prompt and is eaten. local greeted = false -- Nothing is sent from here any more. char.status arrives during the login -- sequence with state 1 and 2, so 'greeted' was being set at the name prompt -- and the slist went out three seconds later - into the password field, which -- echoes nothing, so the login just failed with no sign of why. -- -- Refreshing is a button now. The panel says what it hasn't got and you press -- [refresh] when you want it, which is the same information one keystroke later -- and never a command the client decided to send on its own. function SP.on_login() if greeted then return end if not U.playing() then return end -- state 1/2 is the login prompt greeted = true if next(SP.skills) == nil then U.note("Spellups: no cached skill table - press [refresh] on the panel, or 'spellup slist'.") end SP.paint() end -- what the button does: read the table if we haven't got one, otherwise just -- find out what's currently running function SP.refresh() if not U.playing() then U.warn("Spellups: not in the game yet.") return end if next(SP.skills) == nil then U.note("Spellups: reading the skill table from the MUD...") send("slist spells", false) else SP.sync() end end -- downcount() sums SP.dropped; leaving it alone across a disconnect means the -- moment you're back and U.playing() goes true, autocast fires off whatever -- debt was outstanding before you dropped, before 'aff' has re-synced anything function SP.on_disconnect() greeted = false SP.dropped = {} end do local n = SP.loadskills() if n > 0 then U.note("Spellups: " .. n .. " skills from cache.") end end U.killhandler(aardkit_spellup_login_handler) aardkit.gmcp.watch("spellup_login", "char.status", "aardkit.spellup.on_login") U.killhandler(aardkit_spellup_disc_handler) aardkit_spellup_disc_handler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDisconnectionEvent", "aardkit.spellup.on_disconnect") U.every("spelluptick", 1, function() SP.tick() if panel:visible() then SP.paint() end end) aardkit.register("spellup", "tracks what's on you and why casts fail", SP.cmd)

Script.name: spellups/autocast
Script.script:
if not (aardkit and aardkit.util and aardkit.register) then if cecho then cecho("\n<firebrick>[Spellups]<reset> needs Aardkit Core. Install that first - Toolbox > Module Manager, priority 1.\n") end return end
--[[ Spellups — autocast Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
Sends exactly one command: 'spellup'. That's the whole feature.
The MUD's own spellup already decides what to cast and refuses the rest — mana, recoveries, nomagic rooms, sleeping, combat-incompatible spells, affects you already have, mutual exclusions, forgetskill. It knows all of that better than a client ever will. See 'help spellup'.
So the only thing worth automating is WHEN to type it, which is what Hadar's plugin was really doing all along: mudsidespellup=1, spellstorecast=10. Watch what falls off, and once enough is down, fire the command.
The AFK gate is the same one Who Poller and bulk appraise use, and it's not configurable — Aardwolf allows assist tools but not unattended automation. ]]
aardkit = aardkit or {} aardkit.spellup = aardkit.spellup or {}
local SP = aardkit.spellup local U = aardkit.util.named("Spellups")
local AC = U.load("spellauto", { on = true, threshold = 10, -- how many of yours have to be down before it fires cooldown = 45, -- seconds between fires; the queue needs time to drain combat = false, -- fire while you're fighting })
SP.AC = AC
local function save() U.save("spellauto", AC) end
local lastfire = 0 local backoff = 0
-- core's now. This one was right - it handled "" and "none" - but it only read -- the enemy name, and there are three signals. One definition, no drift. local fighting = U.fighting
-- how many spellups that are actually ours to recast are currently down function SP.downcount() local n = 0 for id in pairs(SP.dropped) do if SP.skills[id] and SP.is_spellup(SP.skills[id]) and not SP.nope[id] then n = n + 1 end end return n end
-- why it isn't firing, or nil if nothing's stopping it function SP.auto_blocked() if not AC.on then return "switched off" end if not U.playing() then return "not logged in" end -- don't fire at the login prompt if aardkit.whopoll and aardkit.whopoll.afk then return "you're flagged AFK" end if os.time() < backoff then return "backing off (" .. (backoff - os.time()) .. "s)" end if fighting() and not AC.combat then return "in combat" end local wait = AC.cooldown - (os.time() - lastfire) if wait > 0 then return "cooling down (" .. wait .. "s)" end return nil end
function SP.fire(manual) -- Manual still can't send while you're flagged AFK. Everything else here is -- pacing and can be overridden by typing the command, but that one gate is -- the whole reason this module is inside Aardwolf's rules. if aardkit.whopoll and aardkit.whopoll.afk then return false, "you're flagged AFK" end local why = not manual and SP.auto_blocked() if why then return false, why end lastfire = os.time() send("spellup", false) return true end
function SP.autotick() if SP.auto_blocked() then return end local n = SP.downcount() if n < AC.threshold then return end if SP.fire() then U.note("Spellups: " .. n .. " down - sent 'spellup'.") end end
-- {sfail} 10 is "you're resting or sitting". Firing again immediately just -- queues the same refusal, so sit it out rather than spinning. function SP.on_castfail(code) if tonumber(code) == 10 then backoff = os.time() + 30 end end
--- -- commands, folded into the main dispatcher ---
function SP.autocmd(verb, rest) if verb ~= "auto" and verb ~= "now" then return false end
if verb == "now" then local ok, why = SP.fire(true) if ok then U.ok("Sent 'spellup'.") else U.warn("Didn't send: " .. tostring(why)) end return true end
local a, b = U.trim(rest):lower():match("^(%S*)%s*(.*)$")
if a == "" then local why = SP.auto_blocked() U.help("Autocast", { { "state", AC.on and "on" or "off" }, { "threshold", AC.threshold .. " spellup(s) down" }, { "cooldown", AC.cooldown .. "s" }, { "in combat", AC.combat and "yes" or "no" }, { "down now", tostring(SP.downcount()) }, { "holding", why or "nothing - ready" }, { "" }, { "spellup auto on | off", "" }, { "spellup auto <n>", "fire once this many are down" }, { "spellup auto cooldown <s>", "minimum gap between fires" }, { "spellup auto combat", "toggle firing mid-fight" }, { "spellup now", "send 'spellup' right now" }, { "" }, { "It only ever sends 'spellup' - the MUD picks the spells." }, })
elseif a == "on" or a == "off" then AC.on = (a == "on"); save() U.ok("Autocast " .. a .. ".")
elseif a == "combat" then AC.combat = not AC.combat; save() U.ok("Fire in combat: " .. (AC.combat and "on" or "off"))
elseif a == "cooldown" then local n = tonumber(b) if not n or n < 5 or n > 600 then U.warn("Usage: spellup auto cooldown <5-600> (currently " .. AC.cooldown .. "s)") else AC.cooldown = math.floor(n); save() U.ok("At most one 'spellup' every " .. AC.cooldown .. "s.") end
elseif tonumber(a) then local n = tonumber(a) if n < 1 or n > 100 then U.warn("Usage: spellup auto <1-100> (currently " .. AC.threshold .. ")") else AC.threshold = math.floor(n); save() U.ok("Fires once " .. AC.threshold .. " spellup(s) are down.") end
else U.warn("spellup auto on|off|combat|<n>|cooldown <s>") end
return true end
U.every("spellauto", 5, SP.autotick)

Script.name: spellups/extras
Script.script:
if not (aardkit and aardkit.util and aardkit.register) then if cecho then cecho("\n<firebrick>[Spellups]<reset> needs Aardkit Core. Install that first - Toolbox > Module Manager, priority 1.\n") end return end
--[[ Spellups — totems, eye of vigilance, auras, wraith form (stage 3) Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
The subsystems that hang off the same tag stream but aren't plain spellups. Each is independently switchable and every one ships OFF, because none of them fired once in the MUSHclient config — turn on what you actually use.
Everything that sends is behind the same gates as the caster: never while you're flagged AFK, never faster than the pacing interval. ]]
aardkit = aardkit or {} aardkit.spellup = aardkit.spellup or {}
local SP = aardkit.spellup local U = aardkit.util.named("Spellups")
local EX = U.load("spellextras", { totem = { on = false, kind = nil, autocast = false, announce = true }, eye = { on = false, autocast = false, announce = true }, aura = { on = false, bag = nil, items = {} }, -- skillnum -> item id wraith = { on = false, pre = {} }, -- skillnum -> true, cast before wraith }) EX.totem = EX.totem or { on = false, announce = true } EX.eye = EX.eye or { on = false, announce = true } EX.aura = EX.aura or { on = false, items = {} } EX.wraith = EX.wraith or { on = false, pre = {} }
SP.EX = EX
local function save() U.save("spellextras", EX) end
-- shared gate: nothing here sends while you're away local function may_send() if aardkit.whopoll and aardkit.whopoll.afk then return false end return true end
local function announce(on, msg, colour) if not on then return end if colour == "bad" then U.warn(msg) elseif colour == "good" then U.ok(msg) else U.note(msg) end end
--- -- totems -- -- Recovery 65 is "Create Totem" (confirmed in the recoveries table), so the -- recast window is known the moment {recoff} 65 lands - no guessing at timers. ---
SP.totem = SP.totem or { up = false, kind = nil, placed = 0, cast = 0, killed = 0 }
local TOTEM_RECOVERY = 65
function SP.on_totem_placed(kind) SP.totem.up, SP.totem.kind, SP.totem.placed = true, kind, os.time() SP.totem.cast = SP.totem.cast + 1 if EX.totem.kind == nil then EX.totem.kind = kind; save() end announce(EX.totem.announce, "Totem up: " .. tostring(kind), "good") end
function SP.on_totem_attacked(who) announce(EX.totem.announce, "Totem attacked by " .. tostring(who) .. "!", "bad") end
function SP.on_totem_killed(who) SP.totem.up = false SP.totem.killed = SP.totem.killed + 1 announce(EX.totem.announce, "Totem killed by " .. tostring(who) .. ".", "bad") end
function SP.on_totem_expired() SP.totem.up = false announce(EX.totem.announce, "Totem expired.", nil) end
--- -- eye of vigilance -- -- Recovery 66 is "Vigilance". The eye is per-zone, so remember where it went; -- "is my eye up" is really "is it up HERE". ---
SP.eye = SP.eye or { up = false, zone = nil, at = 0 }
local EYE_RECOVERY = 66
function SP.on_eye_msg(text) -- <Eye> lines are the eye reporting from wherever it is if not EX.eye.on then return end announce(EX.eye.announce, "Eye: " .. tostring(text), nil) end
function SP.on_eye_up() local _, _, zone = U.room() SP.eye.up, SP.eye.zone, SP.eye.at = true, zone, os.time() announce(EX.eye.announce, "Eye placed in " .. tostring(zone or "?"), "good") end
function SP.on_eye_closed() SP.eye.up = false announce(EX.eye.announce, "Eye has closed.", nil) end
function SP.on_eye_removed(where) SP.eye.up = false announce(EX.eye.announce, "Eye removed from " .. tostring(where), nil) end
--- -- recovery-driven recasts -- -- Both the totem and the eye are gated by a recovery rather than a duration, so -- the honest trigger for "you can have another" is {recoff} on that number. ---
function SP.on_recovery_clear(recnum) recnum = tonumber(recnum) if not recnum or not may_send() then return end
if recnum == TOTEM_RECOVERY and EX.totem.on then announce(EX.totem.announce, "Totem is ready to recast.", nil) if EX.totem.autocast and EX.totem.kind and not SP.totem.up then send("cast 'gaias totem' " .. EX.totem.kind, false) end elseif recnum == EYE_RECOVERY and EX.eye.on then announce(EX.eye.announce, "Eye is ready to recast.", nil) if EX.eye.autocast and not SP.eye.up then send("cast 'eye of vigilance'", false) end end end
--- -- auras -- -- Some effects come from wearing an item rather than casting. When the matching -- affect drops, fetch it from its bag and wear it. Keyed on skill number so it -- works for any aura, not just sanctuary. ---
function SP.on_aura_drop(skillnum) if not (EX.aura.on and may_send()) then return end local item = EX.aura.items[skillnum] if not item then return end if EX.aura.bag then send("get " .. item .. " " .. EX.aura.bag, false) end send("wear " .. item, false) U.note("Aura: wearing " .. item .. " to replace " .. ((SP.skills[skillnum] and SP.skills[skillnum].name) or skillnum)) end
--- -- wraith form -- -- Wraith form drops other affects when it lands, so anything in the pre-list -- gets cast first rather than immediately after. ---
function SP.wraith_pre() if not (EX.wraith.on and may_send()) then return end local n = 0 for id in pairs(EX.wraith.pre) do local s = SP.skills[id] if s then n = n + 1 tempTimer(n * 1.5, function() if may_send() then send("cast '" .. s.name .. "'", false) end end) end end if n > 0 then U.note("Wraith: pre-casting " .. n .. " spell(s).") end end
--- -- commands, folded into the main dispatcher ---
local function toggle_item(set, key, label) local id = tonumber(key) or SP.byname[(key or ""):lower()] if not id or not SP.skills[id] then U.warn("Don't know a spell called '" .. tostring(key) .. "'.") return end set[id] = not set[id] or nil save() U.ok(SP.skills[id].name .. ": " .. label .. " " .. (set[id] and "on" or "off")) end
function SP.extrascmd(verb, rest) rest = U.trim(rest)
if verb == "totem" then local a, b = rest:match("^(%S*)%s*(.*)$") if a == "" then U.help("Totem", { { "tracking", EX.totem.on and "on" or "off" }, { "autocast", EX.totem.autocast and "on" or "off" }, { "type", tostring(EX.totem.kind or "-") }, { "state", SP.totem.up and ("up since " .. os.date("%H:%M", SP.totem.placed)) or "down" }, { "cast/killed", SP.totem.cast .. " / " .. SP.totem.killed }, { "" }, { "spellup totem on|off", "track totem messages" }, { "spellup totem autocast", "recast when the recovery clears" }, { "spellup totem type <t>", "which totem to cast" }, }) elseif a == "on" or a == "off" then EX.totem.on = (a == "on"); save(); U.ok("Totem tracking " .. a .. ".") elseif a == "autocast" then EX.totem.autocast = not EX.totem.autocast; save() U.ok("Totem autocast " .. (EX.totem.autocast and "on" or "off") .. ".") elseif a == "type" then EX.totem.kind = b ~= "" and b or nil; save() U.ok("Totem type: " .. tostring(EX.totem.kind or "-")) end return true
elseif verb == "eye" then local a = rest:match("^(%S*)") if a == "" then U.help("Eye of Vigilance", { { "tracking", EX.eye.on and "on" or "off" }, { "autocast", EX.eye.autocast and "on" or "off" }, { "state", SP.eye.up and ("up in " .. tostring(SP.eye.zone)) or "down" }, { "" }, { "spellup eye on|off", "track eye messages" }, { "spellup eye autocast", "recast when the recovery clears" }, }) elseif a == "on" or a == "off" then EX.eye.on = (a == "on"); save(); U.ok("Eye tracking " .. a .. ".") elseif a == "autocast" then EX.eye.autocast = not EX.eye.autocast; save() U.ok("Eye autocast " .. (EX.eye.autocast and "on" or "off") .. ".") end return true
elseif verb == "aura" then local a, b = rest:match("^(%S*)%s*(.*)$") if a == "" then local rows = { { "auto-wear", EX.aura.on and "on" or "off" }, { "bag", tostring(EX.aura.bag or "-") }, { "" }, } for id, item in pairs(EX.aura.items) do rows[#rows + 1] = { (SP.skills[id] and SP.skills[id].name) or tostring(id), tostring(item) } end rows[#rows + 1] = { "" } rows[#rows + 1] = { "spellup aura on|off", "wear an item when its affect drops" } rows[#rows + 1] = { "spellup aura bag <id>", "container to fetch from" } rows[#rows + 1] = { "spellup aura set <spell> <itemid>", "" } U.help("Auras", rows) elseif a == "on" or a == "off" then EX.aura.on = (a == "on"); save(); U.ok("Aura auto-wear " .. a .. ".") elseif a == "bag" then EX.aura.bag = b ~= "" and b or nil; save() U.ok("Aura bag: " .. tostring(EX.aura.bag or "-")) elseif a == "set" then local spell, item = b:match("^(%S+)%s+(%S+)$") local id = spell and (tonumber(spell) or SP.byname[spell:lower()]) if not id or not item then U.warn("Usage: spellup aura set <spell> <item id>") else EX.aura.items[id] = item; save() U.ok((SP.skills[id] and SP.skills[id].name or id) .. " -> item " .. item) end end return true
elseif verb == "wraith" then local a, b = rest:match("^(%S*)%s*(.*)$") if a == "" then local rows = { { "enabled", EX.wraith.on and "on" or "off" }, { "" } } for id in pairs(EX.wraith.pre) do rows[#rows + 1] = { (SP.skills[id] and SP.skills[id].name) or tostring(id), "" } end rows[#rows + 1] = { "" } rows[#rows + 1] = { "spellup wraith on|off", "" } rows[#rows + 1] = { "spellup wraith <spell>", "add/remove from the pre-cast set" } U.help("Wraith form pre-cast", rows) elseif a == "on" or a == "off" then EX.wraith.on = (a == "on"); save(); U.ok("Wraith pre-cast " .. a .. ".") else toggle_item(EX.wraith.pre, a, "wraith pre-cast") end return true end
return false end
